reviews.comment: All 6 checklist items pass; macOS native recursive watch + 100ms debounce verified live (1 touch → 1 frame, 5-touch burst → 1 frame). Non-blocking notes: no automated watcher test, no error listener on watchers, refreshSubdirs runs on every root event. Linux fallback ships untested on linux but gated by process.platform.

Mobile Safari shows yellow (reconnecting) live-dot; mutations do not repaint. Two blockers: (1) no WS keep-alive ping, Safari kills idle WS; (2) ws.onopen does not refetch state on reconnect. Verify same on desktop.
